==Biography==
Reginald originally came from San Jose, California, USA. On September 2009, Reginald created the [[SoloMid.Net]] website. At this time he was part of team '''All or Nothing'''. 

After the team disbanded due to conflict between Reginald and [[Dan Dinh]] on what the team needed, as well as differences in play-style between the brothers, he moved onto [[Team SoloMid]] in 2011 and became the mid laner for the team.<ref>[http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mOohZzDGgVQ Dan Dinh Interview - Family DINHasty - IPL League of Legends] ''youtube.com''</ref> He has competed at LAN events such as [[MLG]], IEM, and IPL. Currently his main champions are {{ci|Ahri}}, {{ci|Cassiopeia}}, {{ci|Morgana}}, {{ci|Kennen}}, {{ci|Karthus}}, {{ci|Gragas}}, {{ci|Galio}}, {{ci|Twisted Fate}}, {{ci|Ryze}} and in rare cases {{ci|Ziggs}}. After the [[Season 2 World Championship]], Reginald announced his retirement from professional League of Legends and said he would become a manager for Team SoloMid, but later announced that he would instead remain as the team's Mid Laner; he has since stepped down from Mid Lane and has become the team's Coach/Analyst.

On August 14, 2014, it was announced that Reginald violated the LCS rules by refusing to apply the instructions or decisions of LCS officials by announcing [[Lustboy]] as new player of TSM without Riot's final approval. He was fined $ 2,000.<ref>[http://na.lolesports.com/articles/na-lcs-competitive-ruling-andy-%E2%80%9Creginald%E2%80%9D-dinh NA LCS Competitive Ruling - Andy “Reginald” Dinh] ''na.lolesports.com''</ref>

==Playstyle==
Reginald is known for having a very aggressive playstyle in the mid lane, roaming a lot and attempting for kills in lane. He later on switched to a more balanced playstyle, knowing when to go aggressive and when not to.

== Trivia ==
* Founder, owner, and formerly the captain and shot caller of [[Team SoloMid]].
* Known for his strategic abilities.
* Known for his BAY LIFE Empire.
* Known for his aggressive play-style, especially in Season 1.
* Known for his {{ci|Shaco}} and {{ci|Kayle}} in his early LoL career.
* Known for his {{ci|Karthus}},{{ci|Cassiopeia}}, and {{ci|Gragas}} in Season 2.
* Nicknamed 'Rageinald' for his temper.
* Brother of [[Dan Dinh]] and Jonas Dinh.<ref>[http://ggchronicle.com/team-solomid-acquires-new-coach/ Team SoloMid Acquires New Coach] ''ggchronicle.com''</ref>
* Some of his teammates have called him the "sponge" of TSM as he absorbs all of the hate, for example when [[Chaox]] was removed from the team he claimed it was his decision and his alone.
* Got a penta kill in the [[Sound Blaster Nations Championship]] with {{ci|Gragas}} which is considered one of the first penta kills in competitive League of Legends.
* The origin of the name Reginald came from Andy trying to think of the most annoying, hated name he could, hence Reginald.<ref>[http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WNpK76KUZkM/ How a pro player gets his name] ''youtube.com''</ref>
* One of five players to have qualified for the first three World Championships, along with [[Dyrus]], [[TheOddOne]], [[Xpecial]], and [[YellOwStaR]].
* Infamously memed for accidentally pulling out Blue Card as {{ci|Twisted Fate}} in multiple games.
